newsitem.title: USA: Nationwide Financial Q1 shr $0.51 vs $0.38.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide Financial Q1 shr $0.51 vs $0.38.

text.p: (Dollars in millions, except per share data)
Pro Forma Earnings Per Share (A) Net operating income 0.41 0.32

(A) Supplemental pro forma earnings per share data gives effect to (a) the March 6, 1997, initial public offering of common stock and companion offerings of senior debt and trust preferred securities and (b) the special dividends paid by NFS, as if the transactions had occurred at the beginning of each period presented. Accordingly, in each period presented, pro forma earnings per share give effect to a full quarter of interest expense associated with the senior debt and trust preferred securities, assumed investment income foregone on the special dividends to Nationwide Mutual and investment income assumed on the proceeds from the debt and equity offerings.

(B) Pro forma weighted average shares outstanding gives effect to the March 6, 1997, initial public offering of common stock, which includes 23.6 million Class A common shares issued in the initial public offering and subsequent underwriters' overallotment, and 104.8 million Class B common shares held by Nationwide Mutual.
Full company name is Nationwide Financial Services Inc
